host.exposure: edge bound to 127.0.0.1:28080/28443 (TCP) and 127.0.0.1:28443 (UDP); no public port opened

versions.application: the RagX API image and the client and admin web images, pinned by digest in a loopback registry

protocols.method: benches/protocols.sh: 2000 requests per round, 16 parallel, one curl binary for both protocols, inside the apps network to edge:8443, API /health behind HAProxy, edge CPU from the container cgroup; wall time includes the client container start
protocols.reading: On a loss-free sub-millisecond path HTTP/3 brings no edge advantage: about 7% lower throughput, equal CPU. Its value is on lossy, high-RTT client paths, which this lab does not model.
proof: curl --http3-only through the published UDP port 127.0.0.1:28443 answered HTTP/3 200
HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2 over TCP answered 200 with X-Release, Alt-Svc h3=":28443", HSTS, X-Request-ID, nosniff and no Server header
plain HTTP answered 308 to HTTPS; an unknown Host answered 404

guards: redeploying inside the retention window refused: slot keeps the previous release for rollback
a live WebSocket on the retiring slot made the deploy wait 30 s and refuse; after the session closed the deploy succeeded
a concurrent deploy refused on the lock (exit 1) while the first completed
a stale lock with a dead owner blocked deploys until recover --force, which resumed idempotently
edge drift refused before any slot retirement until edge apply
edge apply hot-reloaded HAProxy (container kept, new worker) and kept the previous configuration for rollback
an unpinned API_IMAGE failed validation with exit 1

data.backup_restore: 50000 rows with $, quotes and newlines restored into a new database with an identical count and md5
refusals: a dump whose checksum does not match
data.timer: a user systemd timer installed from the release bundle ran the backup with Result=success, then stopped

control_plane.portainer: installed on loopback with a private CA whose key is deleted after issuance, verified TLS, an API key minted into a mode-600 secret, the pull registry registered through the API
control_plane.export: the desired Compose artifact keeps ${API_REPLICAS}, ${DEPLOY_SLOT} and ${RELEASE_ROOT}, carries no host path or secret, and validates with docker compose under Portainer-style variables

unverified: Docker Hub private push and pull: no Docker Hub credentials were supplied; the driver differs from GHCR only in host and Portainer type, both covered by offline tests
public UDP 443 through a cloud firewall, Let's Encrypt issuance, Cloudflare API, S3 backup upload: they need public DNS, a cloud firewall rule or provider accounts

private_git_and_registry.where: GitHub Actions run 39214929789 in the private repository comstrx/infra-lab-gitops, Ubuntu 24.04 runner with Docker 28.0.4 and Compose 2.38.2; the job-scoped GITHUB_TOKEN reached the tool only through REGISTRY_TOKEN and GITOPS_TOKEN in the environment
private_git_and_registry.registry: registry login and registry push sent the RagX API image to private ghcr.io/comstrx/lab-api, every local copy was removed, and the deploy pulled it back by digest with the stored credentials; portainer registry registered ghcr.io with authentication
private_git_and_registry.gitops: reconcile cloned the private branch and the protected release tag, verified the desired files and Compose checksum, and Portainer created authenticated Git stacks from the private repository whose GitConfig.ConfigHash equaled the verified commit
